entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 9173 of 2023

Applicant :- Suraj Kumar
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P Thru. Addil. Chief Secy. Home Civil Secrt. Lko.

And 3 Oth
Counsel for Applicant :- Bal Keshwar Srivastava,Versha Rani Srivastava,Vimal Kishore Sri
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.

Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and Sri Ravi Shankar Mishra,
who has filed Vakalatnama on behalf of the complainant and perused the record.
The Vakalatnama is taken on record.
2. The FIR in question was lodged as missing person report.
Subsequently in the statement under Sections 161 of 164 of Cr.P.C., the victim admitted that she was left with the applicant on her own freewill.

The age of the victim as per Class-VIII certificate is about 21 years, as per High School certificate 17 years and 9 months and as per the medical report, the age of the victim is around 16 to 18 years, thus, the age of the victim is not crystallized as of now, which shall be determined at the Suraj Kumar vs State Of U.P Thru. Addil.

3. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.
4. In view of the law laid down by this Court in the case of Monish vs State of U.P., (Criminal Misc.
Bail Application No.55026 of 2021), decided on 09.02.2023 coupled with the fact that the applicant is in custody since 17.11.2022 and has no criminal antecedents, there is nothing on record to demonstrate that the applicant if enlarged on bail, would in any way adversely affect the trial and without expressing any opinion on merit, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.

sentences.text: 5. Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Suraj Kumar be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No.98 of 2022, under Sections 363, 366, 376 IPC, Section 5(L)(6) of POCSO Act, Police Station Maheshganj, District Pratapgarh on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
